newsitem.title: USA: CHS Electronics buys three companies.
newsitem.headline: CHS Electronics buys three companies.

text.p: CHS Electronics Inc said it has completed the purchase of three privately-held micro computer distribution companies based in Miami and The Czech Republic, with combined 1996 revenue of $201 million.
It also announced that it has signed a letter of intent to purchase a fourth company located in Denmark.

The companies, acquired for CHS shares and cash to be paid after earn-out periods of one and two years, are Miami-based International High Tech Marketing Inc, with 1996 revenue of $12.5 million; Dinexim, the trade name for Dinoral Corp, with 1996 revenue of $152 million.

The other two companies are Acces and Agora s.r.o., with 1996 revenue of $36 million, based in The Czech Republic. The signed letter of intent is with Lars Krull A.S. which had 1996 revenue of $70 million and is based in Alborg, Denmark.
"These companies are all profitable, and we expect their purchase to be accretive," Claudio Osorio, CHS Electronics' chairman said in making the announcement.
Osorio continued, "We are forecasting combined 1997 revenue for the four companies of $375 million."
